block.business_state.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.business_state.model.title: Business State
block.business_state.model.description: Persist correlated records with optimistic revisions, explicit transitions and a bounded event journal.
block.business_state.help_namespace: Partition within this block instance. Changing it selects a different state partition.
block.business_state.help_initial_state: State assigned to new records; it must be a key in transitions.
block.business_state.help_transitions: Allowed next states by current state. An empty array makes a state terminal.
block.business_state.help_max_records: Maximum retained records per namespace. Records are never deleted automatically.
block.business_state.help_max_journal: Maximum recent transitions kept per namespace. Older journal entries are pruned.
block.business_state.help_max_dedup: Maximum event IDs retained per namespace. A full deduplication ledger refuses new mutations.
block.business_state.help_retention_sec: Journal and event-ID retention in seconds. Replay protection expires after this delay; record revisions still apply.
block.business_state.help_max_bytes: Maximum bytes in one JSON request or record payload.
block.business_state.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
